perfil.resumo: Commentary shorts: a narrator retells and comments a viral clip WHILE the clip plays — same length/pacing/flow as the original short, but rewritten, with a stronger hook in the first second and an ending question that starts a debate in the comments. Visual: the raw clip itself, cut to follow every sentence, with quick zooms, a red tracking circle/arrow on the key object, one-word white captions with outline in the middle, a whoosh on the first cut and something changing every 3-4 s.

ritmo.cortes: cut when the narration moves to another moment of the clip — decided by the story, not by a timer; zoom in on a detail/emotion, zoom out to reveal, still when the image speaks for itself; no silent gaps; the video ends exactly when the voice ends

gancho.descricao: first sentence = a curiosity/contradiction/surprising claim, landing fast on the first moment of the clip
exemplos: Everyone thought this young cyclist was being rude…
This guy found something nobody else at the stadium noticed.
[gasp] She had no idea the camera was still rolling.

estrutura.descricao: the stronger hook over the first clip (< 3 s, punch-in + whoosh)
what people thought / what we see at first
the twist nobody noticed — show it on the clip, red circle/arrow tracking the key object
ONE engaging question the comments will argue about — the video cuts the moment it ends

perfil.tom: storyteller who noticed what everyone missed: curious, warm, a little dramatic; never mean
perfil.linguagem: spoken English, short sentences, one flowing paragraph; Chatterbox voice tags like [gasp] [surprised] at 1-4 natural moments

composicoes.descricao: the piece of the raw clip that shows exactly what the sentence says, full screen 9:16 (crop/zoom)
red circle (object) or arrow (person) tracking the thing the narrator points at

textos_tela.descricao: no big text: the one-word caption does the job

sfx.descricao: sound only where something HAPPENS in that moment (a fast transition, a hit, a reveal, a crowd reaction) — chosen by the context of each video, never the same pattern every time; a moment can have no sound

musica.descricao: soft emotional/curious background track, low under the voice

evitar: copying the reference sentences word for word
silent gaps or a still frame without narration
talking about something while the screen shows something else
keeping the video running after the voice-over ends
inventing names/places not in the clip

metricas.obs: estrutura dos 2 tutoriais de shorts de comentário; tamanho, cortes, zoom e sons variam com cada vídeo (v84_253)
